each_point_is_a_model_score_vs_cost_per_: Each point is a model: score vs. cost per task at API prices. Cheaper is farther right. Click ▾ on a chip to add more versions; older versions are paler. The sources use different test sets, so don't compare their scores.
large_filled_dot_my_regular_choice: Large filled dot: my regular choice
large_filled_dot_ring_regular_and_defaul: Large filled dot + ring: regular and default
hover_over_a_point_to_see_intelligence_c: Hover over a point to see Intelligence, Cost, Speed, Verbosity, and Latency.
hover_over_a_point_to_see_score_and_cost: Hover over a point to see Score and Cost per task. ARC-AGI-2 is abstract reasoning puzzles, not coding.
hover_over_a_point_to_see_score_cost_and: Hover over a point to see Score, Cost, and Tokens per task, the 95% margin, and the agent that ran it.
hover_over_a_point_to_see_score_cost_tok: Hover over a point to see Score, Cost, Tokens, and Steps per task.
no_codex_cursorbench_has_not_scored_a_cu: No Codex: CursorBench has not scored a current GPT model yet, and retired GPT versions are not charted.
people_compare_two_anonymous_answers_and: People compare two anonymous answers and vote for the better one. LMArena fits every vote at once (Bradley-Terry) into an Elo-style score: who a model beats, and how often, counts, not how many votes it gets. Rank follows the score. Fewer votes only widen the 95% CI, so a model with a wide CI may really sit several places higher or lower. No cost, so it is a list, not a chart.
turn_on_at_least_one_provider: Turn on at least one provider.
none_of_these_models_have_data_for_this_: None of these models have data for this Y axis.
official_model_guidance_thinking_levels_: Official model guidance, thinking levels and API prices per 1M tokens. Missing data is shown as —.
vendor_order_click_a_price_or_score_head: Vendor order. Click a price or score header to sort.
standard_api_prices_in_us_dollars_not_su: Standard API prices in US dollars, not subscription quota.
aa_score_artificial_analysis_intelligenc: AA score: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at high effort.
guidance_start_most_coding_and_knowledge: Start most coding and knowledge work on Opus 5.5.
guidance_fable_5_2_demanding_reasoning_a: Fable 5.2: demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work; the most ambitious open-ended technical work. $8 / $40
guidance_opus_5_5_strongest_daily_driver: Opus 5.5: strongest daily driver, for long-running agentic coding and knowledge work. $4 / $20
guidance_sonnet_5_5_best_combination_of_: Sonnet 5.5: best combination of speed and intelligence. For agentic coding, medium for well-specified tasks, high for harder or longer ones. $2 / $10
guidance_haiku_5_5_high_volume_latency_s: Haiku 5.5: high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks such as classification, extraction and routing. $0.10 / $0.50
guidance_no_default_named_and_no_model_l: No default named and no model labelled for agentic coding; without a model set, the client uses a recommended one.
guidance_gpt_6_astra_most_capable_for_co: GPT-6 Astra: most capable, for complex work across code, apps and research. $10 / $50
guidance_gpt_6_1_sol_near_astra_at_a_low: GPT-6.1 Sol: near Astra at a lower cost. $2 / $10
guidance_gpt_6_1_terra_fast_and_efficien: GPT-6.1 Terra: fast and efficient; visual reasoning, precise computer use and clear writing. $1 / $5
guidance_gpt_6_luna_lightweight_high_vol: GPT-6 Luna: lightweight; high-volume, narrowly scoped tasks such as summaries and extraction. $0.10 / $0.50
guidance_antigravity_google_recommends_o: Antigravity: Google recommends Orchestrator for day-to-day development. Carbon or Argon plans and reviews; Hydrogen implements. Standalone models let you set thinking levels.
guidance_low_most_efficient_significant_: low: most efficient; significant token savings with some capability reduction. For simpler tasks that need the best speed and lowest cost, such as subagents.
guidance_medium_api_default_one_level_be: medium (API default, one level below Opus 5's high): balanced, with moderate token savings. For agentic tasks that balance speed, cost and performance.
guidance_high_spends_as_many_tokens_as_t: high: spends as many tokens as the task needs for excellent results. For complex reasoning, difficult coding problems and agentic tasks.
guidance_xhigh_extended_capability_for_l: xhigh: extended capability for long-horizon work. For long-running agentic and coding tasks (over 30 minutes) with token budgets in the millions.
guidance_max_absolute_maximum_capability: max: absolute maximum capability with no constraints on token spending. For tasks needing the deepest reasoning and most thorough analysis.
guidance_effort_sets_how_much_work_goes_: Effort sets how much work goes into the whole response, thinking and tool calls included.
guidance_lower_effort_fewer_combined_too: Lower effort: fewer, combined tool calls; acts without preamble; confirms tersely.
guidance_higher_effort_more_tool_calls_e: Higher effort: more tool calls; explains the plan first; summarizes changes in detail.
guidance_effort_names_do_not_mean_the_sa: Effort names do not mean the same amount of thinking across models.
arena_text_note: Text: general chat, the original Chatbot Arena. Rank is LMArena's own, among all models it rates.
arena_webdev_note: WebDev: building web apps from a prompt. Rank is LMArena's own, among all models it rates.
chart_description: {{score}} vs. cost per task. Higher cost on the left, $0 on the right. Y axis: {{axis}}.
guidance_sorted: Sorted by {{field}}, {{direction}}. Click the header again to reverse, a third time for the original order.
gemini_policy: My Gemini choices: {{daily}} for routine work; explicitly request {{optional}} for one handoff when high is insufficient. {{security}} for security, prioritizing safety and correctness. {{excluded}} is excluded because of cost.
